_comment: Written by hand. A web change to a tool's description that the desktop ships before the next capture by scripts/agent/capture_web_tools.py: specs.json and tests/fixtures/agent/tools.json stay the capture at their web_commit, untouched, and agent::tools::specs replaces each hunk's `from` with its `to` when it loads specs.json. A capture from a web commit that already has a hunk fails agent::tools::specs::tests until its entry is removed here.

hunks.why: openalgo-charts 2.7.5 draws 113 indicators; the new pivot-points is pivot_points in openalgo.ta as well.
pivot-points makes 41 indicators in both libraries, five of them spelled with a hyphen in one and an underscore in the other.
hunks.from: Only 40 indicators exist in both, four of them
hunks.to: Only 41 indicators exist in both, five of them
